pi.frontmatter:
name: session-handoff
description: "把这段对话无损交给另一个 agent：目标、事实、决定、未决、原文、下一步。触发：交接对话 / 换个会话继续"

cursor.frontmatter:
name: session-handoff
description: >-
  Writes a lossless handoff of this conversation for another chat or agent:
  goal, confirmed facts, rejected ideas, decisions, open questions, verbatim
  evidence, and the next action. Use when the user names session-handoff or
  asks to transfer this thread. Does not paraphrase away paths, numbers, tags,
  errors, or commands.
disable-model-invocation: true
